newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nissan says British unit to produce new Primera.
newsitem.headline: Nissan says British unit to produce new Primera.

text.p: Nissan Motor Co Ltd said on Tuesday that its British unit would produce a new Primera Wagon model designed to meet European demand for leisure-style vehicles.

The new model will be based on the Primera which the British unit -- Nissan Motor Manufacturing (UK) Ltd -- currently produces, and succeed the Primera Wagon now exported to Europe from Japan, Nissan said in a statement.

Nissan also said it would invest an additional 70 million stg in the unit to back up its production of the new model. The unit plans an annual production volume of 20,000 units. Nissan said the move would increase the percentage of European-made Nissan vehicles sold in the European market. It would also further heighten the importance of the British unit's role as Nissan's manufacturing base in Europe, it said.

Nissan said the decision to produce the new Primera Wagon at the British unit was part of its ongoing effort to establish a corporate structure capable of weathering currency swings and other changes in the global economy.
